title: Calcium's Role
text: The action potential opens voltage-gated calcium channels. Calcium influx triggers vesicle fusion with the membrane - this is why calcium is essential for synaptic transmission.

title: Vesicle Fusion
text: Synaptic vesicles contain thousands of neurotransmitter molecules. When they fuse with the presynaptic membrane, the contents are released into the synaptic cleft through exocytosis.
